network.productionAccess: Private terminal IP reachable through site-to-site VPN

notes: The EasyEcole backend polls the Hikvision device; do not configure a callback URL on the device.
The backend server must be able to reach the terminal IP. Use the same LAN for local testing and a site-to-site VPN in production.
Successful facial access events are imported; face images and biometric templates are not.
